faq.q: What is the origin of Zejna?
faq.a: Zejna is associated with Arabic. Zejna is the Bosnian form of Arabic زَيْنَة (Zayna), meaning 'beauty, adornment'.
Yes — the underlying form زَيْنَة is Arabic.
Zejna can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zejna should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zayna is not a Quranic personal name.
